# bugs #4233: (unsigned char)(nh << 1) passed to a wider parameter is reported to arrive as 0x0100

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/4233/
- Category: [Information needed from the reporter](../../needs-info.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17158
- Recommended action: Ask the reporter for the port, the command line, and a program whose output shows the wrong value.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

A test made from the program in the ticket passes for mcs51 in the small model, for mcs51 in the
large model with `--stack-auto`, and for z80. In this test the parameter of `sink` is
`unsigned long`, and `sink` receives 0 for `(unsigned char)(nh << 1)`. The program was not compiled
with the `unsigned long long` parameter of the ticket. pic16, where the reporter found the
problem, was not built, and the patch attached to the ticket was not applied.

## Reason

The ticket explains how the cast can be removed and what `sink` may then receive. It names no port
and no command line, and it shows no output or assembly with the wrong value. With these, the
case can be reproduced, or the difference from the test above can be found.

## Related

The patch in the ticket changes the code in `decorateType` that removes casts to the type that the
operand already has. Bugs #3674 and #3172 come from the same code, and the fork has a patch for
them in `processParms`. By the code, the patch in this ticket keeps the `CAST` node for the
operands of those two tickets as well. The two patches were not tested together.
